Name: Eleazar, Son of Dodo
Summary: Eleazar, son of Dodo the Ahohite, was one of David's three mighty men. When Israel's men retreated at Pas-dammim, he stood alone and struck the Philistines until his hand clave to his sword, and the Lord wrought a great victory.
KeyStory: Eleazar's hand froze to his sword as he stood alone against the Philistines.
RelatedPeople: King David; Shammah, Son of Agee
LifeLesson: Standing alone when everyone retreats is the very definition of might.
